name: Reconnected
source:
After war ravages the Solarian system, the defeated species of Earth are exiled to the Andromeda galaxy. Millennia later, the warring factions have evolved and forgiven, agreeing to reconnect with one another and share their cultures. Peace seems to be a fleeting promise when diplomats and
civilians alike are mysteriously murdered at the hands of an unknown assailant. Terror and fear grips the city as the killer is on the prowl, and you find yourself locked in the middle of the investigation.

You play as the diplomat sent from the Solarian system, and have to fight to overcome the struggles and challenges of this strange new world with the help of your friends.

Solve the case, protect the people you care about, explore the world, and fall in love through "Reconnected"! Always remember, Things on Zenalyr are Rarely What they Seem to Be.

[From [url=https://kairaiken.itch.io/reconnected]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
战争蹂躏太阳系后，地球上被击败的物种被流放到仙女座星系。几千年后，交战各方已经进化并原谅，同意彼此重新联系并分享他们的文化。当外交官和
平民同样被不明身份的袭击者神秘杀害。当凶手四处潜行时，恐怖和恐惧笼罩着这座城市，而你发现自己陷入了调查之中。

你扮演从太阳系派来的外交官，必须在朋友的帮助下克服这个陌生新世界的斗争和挑战。

通过《重连》破案、保护你关心的人、探索世界、坠入爱河！永远记住，泽纳利尔上的事物很少像看上去那样。

[来自[url=https://kairaiken.itch.io/reconnected]Itch.io[/url]]
